questions.prompt: What does a Juju storage pool map to in a Kubernetes model?
questions.explanation: In Kubernetes models, Juju maps storage pools to available StorageClass resources to dynamically allocate PersistentVolumeClaims.

questions.prompt: How is external web ingress typically provided to workloads in a Juju K8s model?
options: By relating the application to an ingress charm such as traefik-k8s or nginx-ingress-integrator
By manually configuring iptables on host nodes
By running juju expose on the Kubernetes controller
By creating manual DNS A-records in /etc/hosts
questions.answer: By relating the application to an ingress charm such as traefik-k8s or nginx-ingress-integrator
questions.explanation: Juju models ingress via relations, where charms exchange routing metadata with an ingress operator.

questions.prompt: Which command allows operators to supply a custom OCI image to a charm resource?
questions.explanation: 'juju attach-resource' binds local files or OCI image references to declared charm resources.
